title: Photocatalytic prins-like indole addition of tryptophol C2 with aldehydes and ketones
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24870-24877
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09558A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lanxiang Liu, Yunfeng Tao, Menghan Chu, Xiaojian Zhou, Guanben Du, Bei Zhou, Jun Lin
A novel reaction is initiated by cerium-photocatalytic LMCT excitation of an indole alkanol, followed by 1,5-HAT for indole C2 sp2 C–H bond activation, resulting in the indole C2 radical Prins-like addition reaction with aldehydes and ketones.
